The '''Soheras Trench''' was an underwater trench located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. During the [[Massacre of New Coral City]], it was the site of a small prison camp, [[Imperial Extermination Camp 28]]. The trench was located several kilometers from a nearby rebel camp, the [[Ranger Grotto]]. As a part of the massacre ordered by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Darth Krayt]], [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] used the trench as part of an experiment to create a beast which would help in the slaughter of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. Isen succeeded in creating the [[Sea Leviathan]], a [[Sithspawn/Legends|creation]] that was based on the original [[Leviathan (creature)|Sith Leviathan]]. Isen and [[Darth Azard]] traveled to the Soheras Trench in an [[Aquatic Terrain Armored Transport]] in order to awake the Sea Leviathan, and using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], the Sith ordered the beast to destroy the captive Mon Calamari who were residing in Imperial Extermination Camp 28.
